rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the journey itself through places.

example.english: Our tour of Japan this time is packed with activities.
example.traditional: 我哋今次去日本嘅旅程安排得好充實。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 heoi3 jat6 bun2 ge3 leoi5 cing4 on1 paai4 dak1 hou2 cung1 sat6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for making a journey or going on a trip.

example.english: We’re going to tour next month.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4

rows.note: Use this specifically when a performer or group tours different places to perform.

example.english: The band will tour next month.
example.traditional: 個樂隊下個月會巡迴演出。
example.jyutping: go3 ngok6 deoi6 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 ceon4 wui4 jin2 ceot1

rows.note: Use this for an organized in-person guided visit rather than a self-directed tour.

example.english: This museum tour leaves at two in the afternoon.
example.traditional: 呢個博物館導賞團下晝兩點出發。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 bok3 mat6 gun2 dou6 soeng2 tyun4 haa6 zau3 loeng5 dim2 ceot1 faat3

rows.note: Use this for sightseeing or touring scenic places and attractions.

example.english: We are taking a tour of the Forbidden City today.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 jau4 laam5 gu3 gung1

rows.note: Use this when touring an organized site such as a museum, factory, school, or exhibition.

example.english: The guide took us to tour that museum.
example.traditional: 導遊帶我哋參觀嗰間博物館。
example.jyutping: dou6 jau4 daai3 ngo5 dei6 caam1 gun1 go2 gaan1 bok3 mat6 gun2

rows.note: Use this specifically for an entertainer or group travelling between places to perform.

example.english: The band's tour will reach five cities next month.
example.traditional: 樂隊嘅巡迴演出下個月去到五個城市。
example.jyutping: ngok6 deoi6 ge3 ceon4 wui4 jin2 ceot1 haa6 go3 jyut6 heoi3 dou3 ng5 go3 sing4 si5

rows.note: Use this in sports for a series of matches played at different places, typically during an overseas trip.

example.english: Hong Kong's tour this season will take the team to three countries.
example.traditional: 香港隊今季嘅巡迴賽會去三個國家。
example.jyutping: hoeng1 gong2 deoi6 gam1 gwai3 ge3 ceon4 wui4 coi3 wui5 heoi3 saam1 go3 gwok3 gaa1
